notes: Built by build_campaign_aggregate.py from existing sweep_8qubit.py output; no re-simulation was done.

normalized_gap uses span=2*|ground| (sweep_8qubit.py's own approximation), matching the reference targeted_tfim_8qubit pipeline's (top_energy-ground_energy) formula to ~7 significant figures for these Hamiltonians.

No grad_norm/lambda_min/lambda_max/secondary_kind/trap_score/paper_trapped: these require final circuit parameters which were never saved to disk by either pipeline (computed in-memory then discarded).
No 'random' target_selection_mode: this variant does not exist in sweep_8qubit.py.

shot_100 (9th method) is a BORROWED baseline: its 500 rows (5 Hamiltonians x 100 seeds) were copied as-is from D:\yujin\targeted_tfim_8qubit (the reference method_suite campaign), not generated by sweep_8qubit.py. It does not use pauli_schedule at all (finite-shot measurement noise, not gate noise), so the high-noise-vs-normal-schedule mismatch between the two pipelines does not apply to it. Same 5 Hamiltonians, same 100 seeds, same LR/steps/circuit ansatz were confirmed before merging. Per-seed pairing with the other 8 methods is not guaranteed (independent codebases may seed initial circuit parameters differently) -- treat shot_100 comparisons as aggregate-level (rate/mean/median across the 500 rows), not as a seed-matched paired comparison.
No target_masks/: per-seed selected-gate masks were not reconstructed (available on request from eff_scores.json).

H00003 seed00053 top10_fixed diverged to NaN in the original run (confirmed in its run.log: E=nan from stage 1 onward). Treated as bad_final=True at every threshold and excluded from mean/median normalized_gap via nan-aware stats; flagged via a 'diverged' column in detailed_results.csv and 'n_diverged' in the summaries.
